final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes an article about revoking a leaked JWT before it expires. Theme: short-lived access tokens, refresh-token rotation, and an immediate token_version check. The reader should quickly understand that a leaked old token keeps approaching a protected service, while two layered safeguards close its access window.

Summary angle: An old brass key has been copied and still approaches an ornate secure door. The first seal limits the wait through refresh-token rotation; the second seal changes the user's version mark and rejects the old key immediately. Narrative flow: 3-beat process. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject and three supporting narrative beats. Each beat must map to the article rather than generic decoration.
Information blocks:
- Problem: an old access token remains usable before expiry; visual idea: a weathered brass key stops at a glowing security door; visible label: 旧令牌.
- Step 1: short access tokens and one refresh-token family per login rotate at a circular mechanism; visible label: 轮换.
- Step 2: a per-user token_version seal changes at the center of the door, instantly invalidating the old key; visible label: 即时撤销.

Main metaphor: an ornate double-sealed security door and a leaked old key. Subject: one dark navy and oxidized-brass security door with two distinct magical-mechanical seals, the central red version seal visibly changing to a new pattern while a copied old key is blocked outside. Composition/framing: single-point focus, the security door centered, the old key on the left and the rotation mechanism on the right forming a subtle diagonal progression; keep the wide layout readable.
Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: ornate fantasy fashion illustration, lace-like detail, dollhouse elegance, soft magical palette, controlled decorative density. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: ink navy, ivory, oxidized brass, and a restrained deep red accent. Avoid excessive purple.
Visible text policy: allow only these three short Chinese labels: 旧令牌, 轮换, 即时撤销. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter. No people, faces, crowns, dresses, neon skyscrapers, floating chips, or code rain.
Avoid: decorative clutter that competes with the door; illegible text; extra labels; realistic UI; purple-blue neon glow.
